ReturningToPrayer.6: Izinyathelo ezijwayelekile zokuqala kabusha isithandazo ngemva kokuya esikhathini, ngenhliziyo ethule.
ReturningToPrayer.8: Lokhu okuqukethwe kungokwemfundo kuphela. Imibuzo yenkolo kufanele iqinisekiswe izazi ezifanelekile. I-AWA ayikhiphi ama-fatwa noma izinqumo zenkolo ezikhethelwe wena.
ReturningToPrayer.12: Ukuqala kabusha isithandazo, ngaphandle kokuphindisela izithandazo ezidlulile
ReturningToPrayer.14: I-Ghusl iwukageza okukhulu kwenkolo: kubandakanya ukugeza umzimba wonke ngenhloso yokubuyela esimweni sokuhlanzeka kwenkolo (tahara), okudingekayo ukuze kuthandazwe nokwenza ezinye izenzo zokukhonza.
ReturningToPrayer.15: Ngaphambi kokwenza i-ghusl, kubalulekile ukuqiniseka ukuthi ukuya esikhathini kuphelile ngempela: i-ghusl kufanele ilandele, hhayi ukwandulela, ukuqiniseka ukuthi ukopha kuyeke. Ngokuvamile, lokhu kuphela kuyaziwa ngokuma ngokuphelele kokopha, okubonwe isikhathi esanele ukuqeda noma yikuphi ukungabaza — iphuzu elichazwe kabanzi esihlokweni esikhethekile mayelana nokuhlanzeka kwenkolo.
ReturningToPrayer.16: Lokhu kuhlanzeka kuyikho okukuvumela ukuthi ubuyele ezikhathini zokukhonza ezamiswa phakathi nokuya esikhathini.
ReturningToPrayer.18: Akudingeki uzizwe uphoqelekile: i-ghusl ingenziwa lapho nje usukulungele, ngaphandle kwengcindezi, uma sekuqinisekisiwe ngokuqinisekile ukuthi ukuya esikhathini kuphelile.
ReturningToPrayer.19: I-ghusl isekelwe ezimisweni ezijwayelekile ezabelwanayo: inhloso yokuzihlanza, nokugeza umzimba ngokuphelele, kuhlanganise izinwele nesikhumba. Imininingwane eqondile yendlela, nokho, ingahluka ngokwesikole sezomthetho wenkolo esilandelwayo.
ReturningToPrayer.21: Alukho uhlobo oluthile olwethulwa lapha njengolwodwa olusebenzayo: ukubheka isikole noma umbono ojwayele ukuwulandela, noma ukucela iseluleko kusazi esifanelekile, kuzokusiza ufunde imininingwane eqondile efanele isimo sakho.
ReturningToPrayer.22: Uma ukuya esikhathini sekuphelile futhi i-ghusl senziwe, isithandazo siqala kabusha ngokuvamile, ngaphandle kokubambezeleka okuthile noma esinye isimo.
ReturningToPrayer.23: Kuyasiza ukwahlukanisa phakathi kwezimo ezimbili ezilandela imithetho ehlukene: izithandazo ezingenziwanga phakathi nokuya esikhathini ngokuvamile azifezwa kamuva, kanti izinsuku zokuzila ezidlulwe ngoRamadan kumele zifezwe kamuva (qadaa).
ReturningToPrayer.24: Isibonelo, owesifazane osenze isikhathi izinsuku ezi-6 uqala kabusha ukuthandaza ngokujwayelekile ngemva kwe-ghusl, ngaphandle kokuphindisela izithandazo zalezo zinsuku ezi-6. Izinsuku ezi-6 zokuzila ezihambisanayo, nokho, zizofezwa ngemva kukaRamadan.
ReturningToPrayer.26: Ukwenza i-ghusl (ukugeza okukhulu) ukuze ubuyele ekuhlanzekeni kwenkolo
ReturningToPrayer.27: Ukuqala kabusha ukuthandaza ngokujwayelekile, ngaphandle kokubambezeleka
ReturningToPrayer.28: Ukwazi ukuthi izithandazo ezingenziwanga phakathi nokuya esikhathini ngokuvamile azifezwa kamuva
ReturningToPrayer.29: Ukucela iseluleko kwesazi esifanelekile uma kunesimo esithile noma ukungabaza okuqhubekayo

SideEffects.6: Eminye imiphumela ingajwayeleka futhi ibe yesikhashana. Eminye idinga ukunakwa kakhudlwana. Funda ukwahlukanisa phakathi kwezimpendulo ezijwayelekile nezimpawu okufanele zihlolwe.
SideEffects.11: Ukuthi kufanele ucele iseluleko sezokwelapha nini
SideEffects.12: Ukuthi kufanele ufune ukunakekelwa ngokushesha nini
SideEffects.14: Uma othile eqala indlela entsha yokuvimbela inzalo enamahomoni, umzimba ungadinga isikhathi ukuze ujwayele. Izinguquko ezincane zingavela esikhathini, emoyeni, noma ekududuzekeni komzimba.
SideEffects.15: Le miphumela ivame ukuba mincane futhi ingehla kancane kancane. Ukuba khona kwayo akusho ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuthi indlela iyingozi noma ukuthi kudingeka iyekwe.
SideEffects.17: Ukopha okungajwayelekile kungenzeka, ikakhulukazi ekuqaleni kwendlela entsha.
SideEffects.19: Ukuqina noma ubuhlungu bezibele kungezwakala isikhashana.
SideEffects.21: Abanye abantu baqaphela izinguquko zemizwa noma ukuzwela kakhulu ngokomzwelo.
SideEffects.23: Ikhanda elibuhlungu elincane lingenzeka phakathi nesikhathi sokujwayela.
SideEffects.24: Amasonto okuqala noma imijikelezo yokuqala ingahluka kulokho obujwayele ngaphambili. Umzimba ungajwayela kancane kancane ibhalansi entsha yamahomoni.
SideEffects.26: Umphumela ovela ngokushesha ngemva kokuqala indlela ufanele ubhekwe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Uma uba nzima noma uqhubeka, khuluma nongochwepheshe wezempilo.
SideEffects.27: Kungasiza ukuqopha izimpawu ku-app yakho ukuze ubone kangcono ukuthi zishintsha kanjani kusuka emjikelezweni oya komunye.
SideEffects.33: Zonke izimpawu azihlangene ngempela nokuvimbela inzalo. Ukukhathazeka, ukulala, ukudla, umjikelezo wakho, noma ezinye izindlela zokwelashwa nazo zingathinta indlela ozizwa ngayo.
SideEffects.34: Ukuze uqonde isimo, zama ukubuka isimo sonke kunokubuka uphawu olulodwa lodwa.
SideEffects.37: Ukopha okungajwayelekile okuthatha imijikelezo engaphezu kwemi-3
SideEffects.38: Isicanucanu noma ikhanda elibuhlungu eliqhubeka likukhathaza
SideEffects.41: Ingabe zavela ngemva kokuqala noma ukushintsha indlela yokuvimbela inzalo?
SideEffects.42: Ingabe zincane, ziyakhathaza, noma azijwayelekile ngempela kuwe?
SideEffects.43: Ingabe ziyathuthuka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi noma ziya ngokuvama?
SideEffects.44: Ngisho nalapho uphawu lungasheshi, kungaba kuhle ukulukhulumela uma luyakhathaza, luqhubeka, noma lunomthelela ngempela empilweni yakho.
SideEffects.46: izimpawu ziqhubeka, ziba kakhulu, noma zikuvimbela ukuphila ngokujwayelekile.
SideEffects.47: Udokotela, umbelethisi, noma isazi sezemithi singakusiza unqume ukuthi izimpawu zingahle zihlangane nendlela oyisebenzisayo yini nokuthi idinga ukulungiswa yini.
SideEffects.48: Ezinye izimpawu azijwayelekile futhi zidinga ukuhlolwa ngokushesha ngezokwelapha. Akusho ngempela ukuthi kukhona inkinga, kodwa akufanele zinganakwa.
SideEffects.50: Cela iseluleko sezokwelapha ngokushesha uma uzwa, ikakhulukazi:
SideEffects.54: Ikhanda elibuhlungu elizumayo, elinamandla kakhulu, noma elingajwayelekile
SideEffects.55: Ubunzima obuzumayo ekuboneni, ekukhulumeni, noma emandleni
SideEffects.57: Uma izimpawu ziza ngokuzumayo, zinamandla kakhulu, noma zihambisana nobunzima bokuphefumula, ukuzwa sengathi uzocinwa, noma esinye isibonakaliso esibi, cela usizo lwezokwelapha oluphuthumayo.
SideEffects.59: Eminye imiphumela ingavela ekuqaleni kwendlela entsha yokuvimbela inzalo enamahomoni.
SideEffects.60: Imiphumela eminingi iyesikhashana futhi ingehla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
SideEffects.61: Uphawu oluhlupha noma oluqhubekayo lufanele lukhulunywe nongochwepheshe.
SideEffects.62: Ezinye izimpawu ezingajwayelekile zidinga iseluleko sezokwelapha ngokushesha.
SideEffects.64: Ukulalela umzimba wakho akusho ngempela ukumisa indlela ngokushesha. Qaphela ozizwa ngakho, ubuke ukuthi kushintsha kanjani, bese ucela iseluleko noma nini uma uphawu lukukhathaza.
SideEffects.65: Lesi sihloko senzelwe ukwazisa futhi asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha esikhethelwe wena. Uma unophawu olubalulekile noma olungajwayelekile, cela iseluleko kongochwepheshe wezempilo.
SideEffects.66: Ukubona imiphumela engase ibe khona — AWA

SleepHormones.6: Kungani ukulala kwakho kushintsha ngokuya ngesigaba somjikelezo wakho, nasekuyeni ku-menopause.
SleepHormones.14: I-Progesterone inomthelela omncane wokulalisa; ukwehla kwayo ekupheleni komjikelezo kungaphazamisa ukulala, kukwenze kube lula noma kuhlukane.
SleepHormones.16: Ukukhuphuka okuncane kokushisa komzimba ngemva kokukhipha iqanda nakho kungenza ukulala kube nzima kancane kwabanye abantu.
SleepHormones.18: Ukungakhululeki komzimba nokukhathala kungenza ukulala kube lula.
SleepHormones.20: Ukulala ngokuvamile kuzinza kakhulu kubantu abaningi.
SleepHormones.22: Ukwehla kwe-progesterone kungenza ukulala kube lula, kube nokuvuka kwesikhathi esithile.
SleepHormones.23: Ku-menopause, ukujuluka ebusuku kuyimbangela ejwayelekile yokuvuka, ngenxa yezizathu ezifanayo zamahomoni.
SleepHormones.24: Ukukhathazeka kungenza ukuphazamiseka kokulala kube kukhulu ezigabeni zomjikelezo eziselula kakade. Amasu alula okuphumula (ukuphefumula, ukwelula ngobumnene) angakusiza uthuthuke ngaphambi kokulala.
SleepHormones.25: Inqubo yokulala ezinzile nekamelo elipholile kusiza ukunciphisa lokhu kuphazamiseka, kunoma yiluphi uhlelo lweminyaka.
SleepHormones.27: Ukuya embhedeni nokuvuka ngezikhathi ezizinzile kusiza ukulawula ewashi lakho langaphakathi.
SleepHormones.29: Ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kungabambezela ukulala; ukuphumula esikrinini kukusiza uthuthuke.
SleepHormones.31: Izinga lokushisa eliphakathi nendawo likwenza kube lula ukulala, kunoma yiluphi uhlelo lweminyaka.
SleepHormones.32: Imikhuba emihle ayilokothi ibe yanele njalo. Kungaba usizo ukukhuluma nochwepheshe uma:
SleepHormones.35: Ukukhathala kuthinta kakhulu impilo yansuku zonke
SleepHormones.38: Ukuqaphela ukuthi izinkinga sezihlale isikhathi esingakanani nokuthi yini ebonakala ibathinta kungasiza uchwepheshe wezempilo ukukuholela kangcono.
SleepHormones.40: Lezi zinguquko zokulala ziyajwayeleka futhi ngokuvamile ziyesikhashana: azisho ukuthi kukhona okungalungile.
SleepHormones.41: I-Progesterone inomthelela omncane wokulalisa; ukwehla kwayo ekupheleni komjikelezo kungaphazamisa ukulala.

SleepHormones.44: Izinkinga zokulala eziqhubekayo ziyafaneleka ukuxoxwa noochwepheshe bezempilo.
SleepHormones.45: Okuqukethwe kokwazisa. Lesi sihloko asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha esikhethelwe wena. Uma ungabaza, cela isiqondiso kongochwepheshe wezempilo.

UnderstandCycle.8: Izigaba ezinkulu zomjikelezo wakho, zicaciswe ngobulula.
UnderstandCycle.19: Isigaba ngasinye sinendima ebalulekile emzimbeni wakho futhi singathinta amandla akho, isimo sakho sengqondo nezimpawu zakho.
UnderstandCycle.33: Umjikelezo wakho ungahluka kusuka enyangeni eya komunye. Ukukhathazeka, ukulala, ukudla noma ukugula kungathinta ubude bawo nesigqi sawo.
UnderstandCycle.42: Lalela umzimba wakho, qaphela ozizwa ngakho bese ubhala okushintshayo ngokuhamba kwezinsuku.

UnderstandMenstrualFlow.4: Isikhathi sakho siyingxenye yenqubo yemvelo ebalulekile empilweni yamahomoni nenzalo. Ukuqonda okwenzeka emzimbeni wakho kungakusiza uzizwe ukhululekile ngomjikelezo ngamunye.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.10: Isikhathi siwukuhlubuka kongqimba lwesibeletho uma kungenzekanga ukuhlangana kwamaqanda nesidoda. Lokhu kwenzeka cishe kanye ngenyanga.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.12: Wonke owesifazane wehlukile: ubude, amandla nezimvo kungahluka kusuka emjikelezweni oya komunye.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.13: Ukuphuma kwegazi akuhlali kufana isikhathi sonke. Ngokuvamile kushintsha usuku nosuku, emandleni, ebhalweni nasebukhulwini.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.15: Ukuphuma kwegazi kuvame ukuba kuningi kunsuku ezimbalwa zokuqala.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.17: Ukuphuma kwegazi ngokuvamile kuqala ukwehla kancane kancane.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.19: Ukuphuma kwegazi kuba kuncane futhi kungaba nombala omnyama.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.21: Lokhu kungahluka kusuka emjikelezweni oya komunye. Okubaluleke kakhulu ukwazi isigqi sakho esijwayelekile.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.22: Ezinye izinguquko ziyajwayeleka phakathi nesikhathi sakho. Ezinye izimpawu zidinga ukunakwa kakhulu, ikakhulukazi uma ziyintsha noma zinamandla kakhulu.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.28: Kusuka kubomvu obukhanyayo kuya kubomvu obumnyama noma obunsundu ekupheleni kwesikhathi sakho.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.30: Ukuhlushwa yisisu okuncane kuya kokuphakathi nendawo kungezwakala.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.31: Ukuthi kufanele ucele iseluleko sezokwelapha nini?
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.33: Ukopha okugcwalisa iphedi noma i-tampon ngokushesha kakhulu
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.34: Ukukhathala okukhulu, ukuzwa sengathi uzocinwa, noma isiyezi
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.35: Inguquko ezumayo neqhubekayo kulokho okujwayelekile kuwe
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.36: Imikhuba elula ingasiza ukuphumuza ukungakhululeki futhi yenze izinsuku zokuqala zesikhathi sakho zibe lula.

VaginalRing.12: Indandatho iyisisetshenziswa esithambile esikhipha njalo amahomoni amancane ngqo ngaphakathi emvilophini, esinesenzo sokuvimbela inzalo esifana nesepilisi elihlanganisiwe.
VaginalRing.20: Uyifaka wena, ihlala endaweni njalo amasonto amathathu, bese iyakhishwa ukuphumula iviki elilodwa lapho isikhathi sakho senzeka khona.
VaginalRing.27: Isikhundla sayo esiqondile ngaphakathi akudingeki sibe qotho ukuze isebenze, okwenza kube lula ukuyisebenzisa.
VaginalRing.28: Indandatho inamaphuzu amaningi asebenzayo akufanele awazi ngaphambi kokuyikhetha.
VaginalRing.34: Amahomoni akhululeka njalo phakathi nesikhathi sokusetshenziswa.
VaginalRing.38: Geza izandla ngaphambi kokuyifaka noma ukuyikhipha
VaginalRing.39: Khetha isikhathi esilula ukusikhumbula ukuze ulandele ishejuli
VaginalRing.40: Hlola ngezikhathi ezithile ukuthi isendaweni yayo
VaginalRing.41: Bheka incwajana uma ishintsha endaweni noma iphuma
VaginalRing.43: Ukuphuma noma ukuhamba isikhathi eside kungadinga isiqondiso esithile. Hlala ubheka incwajana yesisetshenziswa noma ubuze uchwepheshe wezempilo uma ungaqiniseki.
VaginalRing.48: Ngokuvamile ilandela umjikelezo wamasonto amathathu nokuphumula kweviki elilodwa.
VaginalRing.50: Ukuhlola njalo ukuthi isendaweni kukusiza usebenzise isisetshenziswa ngenhliziyo ethule.
VaginalRing.54: Indandatho yangaphakathi ihlanganisa ukukhululwa okuqhubekayo kwamahomoni nesigqi sokusetshenziswa esigwema umthamo wansuku zonke. Kodwa-ke, ukukhetha indlela yokuvimbela inzalo kufanele kulungiselwe umuntu ngamunye futhi kuxoxwe nochwepheshe wezempilo.

week1.0: Ukukhulelwa kubalwa kusukela osukwini lokuqala lwesikhathi sakho sokugcina, ngokomkhuba wezokwelapha. Kulesi sigaba, ukuhlangana kwamaqanda nesidoda ngokuvamile kungakenzeki.
week1.1: Lesi sikhathi ngokuvamile siza ngaphambi kokukhulelwa; ngokuvamile akukabi khona ushintsho lomzimba olumayelana nokukhulelwa.
week1.2: Ukubala ukukhulelwa kusukela esikhathini sokugcina kunikeza indlela ejwayelekile yokulinganisela usuku lokubeletha, nakuba ukukhulelwa ngempela kwenzeka kamuva kancane.
week1.3: Kuyajwayeleka ukungaqapheli noma yiluphi ushintsho kulesi sigaba.

week2.0: Ukukhipha iqanda nokuhlangana okungenzeka kwamaqanda nesidoda ngokuvamile kwenzeka cishe ngalesi sikhathi, kuye ngobude bomjikelezo womuntu ngamunye.
week2.1: Isikhathi sokukhipha iqanda singahluka kuye ngobude bomjikelezo, okuthinta usuku lokukhulelwa olungenzeka ngempela.
week2.2: Ngokuvamile akukabikho ushintsho lomzimba olukhethekile lokukhulelwa kulesi sigaba.
week2.3: Isikhathi esiqondile sokukhipha iqanda siyahluka kumuntu ngamunye, yingakho lesi sikhathi sihlala siyisilinganiso.

week3.0: Uma ukuhlangana kwamaqanda nesidoda kwenzekile, iqanda liqala ukuhlukana futhi lihambele esibelethweni, kodwa akukabikho okutholakalayo ngovivinyo lokukhulelwa.
week3.1: Leli sonto lisewela esikhathini sokubala sezokwelapha esizungeze ukukhulelwa; ngokuvamile asikho isibonakaliso somzimba esiphawulekayo kulesi sigaba.
week3.2: Ovivinyo lokukhulelwa lomchamo oluningi luthembeka kusukela cishe esontweni elilandelayo, uma ukunamathela sekuqalile.

week4.0: Umbungu usanda kunamathela odongeni lwesibeletho. Isikhwama se-amniotic nesikhwama se-yolk, esizokondla ezinsukwini zokuqala kakhulu, siyakheka.
week4.3: Abanye abantu abaqapheli noma yisiphi isibonakaliso kulesi sigaba sokuqala kakhulu.
week4.4: Ucwaningo lokukhulelwa lomchamo ngokuvamile lungathola ukukhulelwa kusukela kuleli sonto.
week4.5: Lesi yisikhathi esijwayelekile lapho ucwaningo lokukhulelwa lungaqala ukubonisa umphumela omuhle.

week5.0: Uhlelo lwezinzwa luqala ukwakheka, nenhliziyo, esengaphezulu kuncane, isiya ukushaya okokuqala.
week5.3: Ukukhathala okungajwayelekile, isicanucanu esincane, noma izibele ezibuhlungu kungavela.
week5.4: Lesi yisikhathi esinconywayo sokwenza isikhathi sokuhlangana nochwepheshe wezempilo ukuqala ukunakekelwa kokukhulelwa.

week6.0: Amahlumela ezingalo namehlo ayavela, kanye nezigodi ezincane lapho izindlebe zizokwakheka. Inhliziyo ngezinye izikhathi ingatholakala kakade nge-ultrasound.
week6.3: Isicanucanu nokukhathala kungase kwande kwabanye abantu phakathi nalesi sikhathi.
week6.4: Umsebenzi wenhliziyo ngezinye izikhathi ungabonakala kusukela kuleli sonto nge-ultrasound yokuqala.

week7.0: Ubuchopho bukhula ngokushesha kunomzimba osele, kunikeza ibunzi eliphawulekayo. Amahlumela amancane ezandla aqala ukuvela ekugcineni kwezingalo.
week7.3: Ukulangazelela ukudla okuthile, noma ukunengeka ngokudla okuthile, kuyenzeka.
week7.4: Ithyubhu le-neural, elikhiqiza ubuchopho nomgogodla, liqhubeka nokuvaleka phakathi nalawa masonto.

week8.0: Umbungu manje usubizwa ngokuthi yingane esesibelethweni (fetus). Izingalo ziyaba side, ikhanda liqala ukuqonda kancane, futhi i-placenta iyaqhubeka nokwakheka.
week8.3: Ukuzwela iphunga nesicanucanu sasekuseni kuyajwayeleka kulesi sigaba, nakuba kungenjalo kubo bonke.
week8.4: I-ultrasound yokuqala yokuthola isikhathi ngokuvamile ihlelwa phakathi kweviki lesi-8 neleshumi nane.

week9.0: Izici zobuso ziba nobuchule, izinsiba zamehlo zivikela amehlo, nezandla nezinyawo ziyakheka nezinzwani zesikhathi esizayo.
week9.3: Ukukhathala okukhulu nesicanucanu kungase kusabakhona; ngokuvamile kuvame ukwehla ekupheleni kwe-trimester yokuqala.
week9.4: Izitho zangasese zisanda kuqala ukuhlukana, kodwa ubulili ngokuvamile abukwazi ukuhlonzwa kuze kube kamuva kakhulu, nge-ultrasound yesakhiwo.

week10.0: Ubuso buba nokuhlonipheka kakhulu, izinsiba zamehlo ziphendula ekukhanyeni, futhi inhliziyo ishaya ngesivinini esikhulu, cishe izikhathi ezintathu ngokushesha kunesomuntu omdala.
week10.3: Ibhande lakho lingase liqale ukushintsha kancane, nakuba isisu ngokuvamile singakabonakali.
week10.4: Ukuhlolwa okuhlanganisiwe kwe-trimester yokuqala, uma kunikezwa, ngokuvamile kwenziwa phakathi kweviki le-11 neleshumi nane.

week11.0: Iminwe yezandla nezinzwani zezinyawo ziyahlukana, izinzipho ezincane ziyavela, futhi i-placenta kancane kancane ithatha esikhundleni se-yolk sac ekondleni ingane esesibelethweni.
week11.3: Ungase uqaphele ukushintsha kwemizwa, okuhlobene ikakhulukazi nezinguquko zamahomoni.
week11.4: Ukunyakaza kwengane kuyaqala, kodwa ngokuvamile akuzwakali kulesi sigaba.

week12.0: Izitho zangaphakathi nemisipha sekukhule kahle, futhi amathambo aqala ukuqina. Izitho zokuzala ziyakhiwe, nakuba zingabonakali ku-ultrasound okwamanje.
week12.3: Isicanucanu ngokuvamile siyaqala ukwehla kancane kancane cishe ngalesi sikhathi, nakuba lokhu kuhluka kakhulu kumuntu ngamunye.
week12.4: Ukuphela kwe-trimester yokuqala ngokuvamile kuhlotshaniswa nobungozi obuphansi bokukhishwa kwesisu uma kuqhathaniswa namasonto andulele.

week13.0: Ukunyakaza, okusadlalayo, kuya ngokuhlangana kancane. Ezinye izingane sezibonisa umkhuba wokumunca isithupha.
week13.3: Abantu abaningi kancane kancane babuyisela amandla amaningi njengoba i-trimester yesibili isondela.
week13.4: I-trimester yokuqala ngokuvamile iphela cishe kuleli sonto; ukunakekelwa kuyaqhubeka nokuhlangana okuhlukene kakhulu.

week14.0: Ikhanda liba nomumo ojikelezayo futhi lilingana kangcono nomzimba osele. Ingane esesibelethweni iginya uketshezi lwe-amniotic oluncane, oludlula esiswini nasezinyaweni zezinso.
week14.3: Isisu siqala ukuvela ngokubonakalayo kwabanye abantu.
week14.4: Uchwepheshe wezempilo ngezinye izikhathi angaqala ukuzwa ukushaya kwenhliziyo ngethuluzi le-ultrasound elibekwe esiswini.

week15.0: Izinwele ezincane ezibizwa ngokuthi i-lanugo zimboza kancane kancane isikhumba, futhi izinsiba nezinsiba zamehlo ziqala ukuvela. Amehlo aba nozwela ekukhanyeni.
week15.3: Isifiso sakho sokudla singashintsha, ngezinye izikhathi kube nokulangazelela ukudla okusha noma ukunengeka.
week15.4: Ukuzwa kuqala ukukhula cishe ngalesi sikhathi: izwi lakho nemisindo yangaphakathi yomzimba kancane kancane kuyezwakala.

week16.0: Uhlelo lwezinzwa luvumela ukunyakaza kwezingalo namathanga. Izandla zingavaleka zibe izibhakela ezincane.
week16.3: Abanye abantu baqala ukuzwa ukunyakaza okulula kakhulu kusukela cishe ngalesi sikhathi, kuvame ukuchazwa njengokuphapha.
week16.4: Ukuzwa ukunyakaza kokuqala kuhluka kakhulu kokunye ukukhulelwa kuya komunye, ikakhulukazi kuye ngokuthi ngabe kungukukhulelwa kokuqala.

week17.0: Amehlo, asavaliwe, angahamba, futhi ingane manje iphendula emisindweni ephakeme. Izigxivizo zeminwe ziqala ukwakheka.
week17.3: Ubuhlungu obuncane bomhlane bungavela njengoba isikhungo sakho sesisindo sishintsha.
week17.4: Imisindo yangaphandle iqala ukuzwakala, ngendlela ethuliswe, ngoketshezi lwe-amniotic.

week18.0: Ukuzwa, ukuthinta, ukugwinya nomkhuba wokumunca kuyaqhubeka nokukhula. Ingane iya ngokusebenza kakhulu, ineziningi izinyakazo zezingalo namathanga.
week18.3: Isisu ngokuvamile sibonakala ngokucacile kulesi sigaba, futhi isikhungo sakho sesisindo siyaqhubeka nokushintsha.
week18.4: I-ultrasound yesakhiwo, ehlola intuthuko iyonke yengane, ngokuvamile inikezwa phakathi kweviki le-18 neleshumi nanye.

week19.0: Amazinyo ayoba unomphela esikhathini esizayo aqala ukwakheka ngemuva kwamazinyo engane alungiselelwayo, futhi ingane iqhubeka nokukhula kancane kancane ngesisindo.
week19.3: Umuzwa wokudonswa emaceleni esisu (ubuhlungu be-round ligament) ungase wenzeke njengoba isibeletho sikhula.
week19.4: Lesi yisikhathi esijwayelekile sokuqala ukuzwa ukunyakaza kwengane ngokucacile.

week20.0: Kusukela kuleli sonto, ubude bukalwa kusukela ekhanda kuya esithendeni kunokusuka ekhanda kuya ezinqeni, njengoba amathanga manje angelulwa futhi akalwe — lokhu kuchaza ukweqa okubonakalayo osayizini wereferensi uma kuqhathaniswa namasonto adlule.
week20.3: Isisu sakho esiyindilinga kahle singaqala ukuthinta ibhalansi nokuma kwakho.
week20.4: Maphakathi nokukhulelwa kuvame ukuphawulwa ngokuhlolwa okuphelele nochwepheshe wezempilo olandela ukunakekelwa kwakho.

week21.0: Ukunyakaza kuba sobala futhi kuhlangana kakhulu, futhi kuyajwayeleka ukuqala ukukuzwa ngokucacile phakathi nalesi sikhathi.
week21.3: Ukuphelelwa umoya okuncane lapho wenza umzamo kungavela njengoba isibeletho sithatha isikhala esiningi.
week21.4: Ukujwayela indlela yokunyakaza evamile yengane yakho kwenza kube lula ukuqaphela ushintsho olungajwayelekile.

week22.0: Amaphaphu aqhubeka nokukhula, futhi ingane ifunda ukunyakaza okuncane kokuphefumula. Ama-taste buds nawo ayakheka.
week22.3: Ukuhlushwa yisisu emathangeni, ikakhulukazi ebusuku, kungenzeka kwabanye abantu.
week22.4: Lokho okudlayo kungathinta uketshezi lwe-amniotic, okugwinywa yingane njalo.

week23.0: Amalungu manje alinganiswe kahle. Ingane ifunda ukuphefumula futhi iqala ukushintshanisa izigaba zokulala nokuvuka.
week23.3: Ubuhlungu bomhlane obukhulu kakhulu bungavela ngokukhula kancane kancane kwesisindo.
week23.4: Ukubuka izikhathi eziphilayo nezithulile zengane kukusiza ufunde isigqi sayo.

week24.0: Ingane ifinyelela esilinganisweni sokuphila: uma kwenzeka ukuzalwa kusenesikhathi kakhulu kulesi sigaba, ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha kwezingane ezizelwe okukhethekile kungavumela ukusinda, ngosekelo olufanele.
week24.3: Ingcindezi eyengeziwe esinqeni sokuchama nesifiso esivamile sokuchama kungavela.
week24.4: Ukuhlolwa kwesifo sikashukela sokukhulelwa ngokuvamile kunikezwa cishe ngalesi sikhathi.

week25.0: Ingane manje iphendula emisindweni ephakeme ngokuthuka noma ngokukhaba, futhi ukuthuthumela kwesikhathi esithile kungezwakala. Ichama njalo koketshezi lwe-amniotic.
week25.3: Ukuvutha kwesifuba noma i-acid reflux kungavama kakhulu.
week25.4: Ukuthuthumela kwengane okuzwakala ngezikhathi ezithile ngokuvamile kuthathwa njengokujwayelekile.

week26.0: Amehlo avuleka okokuqala. Umbala wawo wokugcina ngokuvamile awuyukwaziwa kuze kudlule izinyanga eziningana ngemva kokuzalwa.
week26.3: Ukuvuvukala okuncane kwamaqakala noma kwezinyawo kungavela, ikakhulukazi ngasekupheleni kosuku.
week26.4: I-trimester yesithathu iyasondela, nokulandelelwa kwezokwelapha ngokuvamile kuya ngokuvama.

week27.0: Amaphaphu aqala ukukwazi ukuqala ukuphefumula, futhi ingane iqhubeka nokugcwala njengoba amafutha eqoqana ngaphansi kwesikhumba.
week27.3: Ukukhathala kungase kubuye njengoba umzimba wakho ukhula isisindo esikhulayo.
week27.4: Ukuqala kwe-trimester yesithathu kuvame ukuba yisikhathi esihle sokuqala ukucabanga ngohlelo lwakho lokubeletha.

week28.0: Izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo, elalisheshe kakhulu ekuqaleni kokukhulelwa, selizinzile cishe emashumini ayi-130 kuya kwayi-140 ngomzuzu futhi manje lingezwakala nge-stethoscope.
week28.3: Ukuphelelwa umoya noma ukuvutha kwesifuba kungase kuvame kakhulu njengoba isibeletho sithatha isikhala esiningi.
week28.4: I-trimester yesithathu ngokuvamile iqala cishe kuleli sonto, nokuhlangana kuya ngokuvama.

week29.0: Ingane isikheke kahle; amasonto azayo ahlose kakhulu ukukhula kwezitho nokukhula kwesisindo. Ungqimba oluncane lokuvikela olumboze isikhumba sayo luqala ukumuncwa.
week29.3: Ukulala kungase kube nzima kakhulu ngenxa yokukhula kwesisu sakho.
week29.4: Ukuphumula uhlangothini lwakho lwesobunxele kuvame ukunconywa ekupheleni kokukhulelwa ukusekela ukuhamba kwegazi.

week30.0: Ukubona kuyaqhubeka nokukhula; lapho izalwa, ingane izokwazi ukuhlonza ubuso obuseduze, ngaphambi kokufunda kancane kancane ukulandela izinto ezihambayo.
week30.3: Umuzwa wesindo ezansi emhlane noma ku-pelvis ungase wande.
week30.4: Izikhathi zokuhlangana zangaphambi kokubeletha ngokuvamile ziya ngokuvama kusukela kulesi sigaba.

week31.0: Ingane inyakaza ngamandla, ngezinye izikhathi imunca iminwe yayo, futhi ingenza ukunyakaza okubanzi. Isikhumba sayo siba nokuguquguquka okuncane njengoba amafutha eqoqana.
week31.3: Ukucindezelwa kokuzilolonga, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-Braxton Hicks, kungase kuqale ukuzwakala ngezikhathi ezithile.
week31.4: Ingane iqala ukuhlonza amazwi athile ajwayelekile ezwakala njalo ngaphandle.

week32.0: Ingane isikheke kahle futhi kancane kancane ikhetha isikhundla sekhanda phansi ukulungiselela ukuzalwa. Ikakhulukazi iqhubeka nokukhula ngesisindo emasontweni asele.
week32.3: Ukukhula kwesisindo okubonakala kakhulu kuyajwayeleka phakathi nalesi sikhathi, okuhlobene nokukhula kwengane.
week32.4: Isikhundla sekhanda phansi (cephalic presentation) siba sivame kakhulu njengoba usuku lokubeletha lusondela.

week33.0: Ubuchopho nohlelo lwezinzwa manje sekukhule kahle. Amathambo aqhubeka nokuqina, ngaphandle kwalawo ekhanda, ahlala ethambile ukwenza kube lula ukudlula ngesikhathi sokuzalwa.
week33.3: Ubunzima bokuthola isikhundla sokulala esinethezekile buyajwayeleka kulesi sigaba.
week33.4: Ukuthamba kwamathambo ekhanda ngesikhathi sokuzalwa kuyisikhashana futhi kancane kancane kuyavaleka phakathi nonyaka wokuqala.
